task: Draft a calm, short text to my ex confirming who's collecting the kids this Friday and where Sunday's handover happens.
text: Can you help me reply to Dariusz? Context: our handover schedule changed after the mediation session on 2 October. Under the new arrangement Kacper and Ola are with me from Friday after school until Sunday 5pm, every other weekend, and Dariusz has them midweek. This Friday I'm stuck at work until 6:30, so my mum, Grażyna Wierzbicka, will collect them from school instead. Dariusz texted from 07700 900662 saying he's 'not comfortable' with that unless I send him her number first, which is fair. Her mobile is 07700 900318. Handover back on Sunday stays at the leisure centre car park on Ashdown Road, not his flat, at 5pm sharp. I don't want to argue, I just want it clear and short, and I'd rather not mention the mediation at all.

text:
Handover for the late shift, re the kettle complaint:
Akosua took the first call. The customer, Mrs Liesel Brandvold, reported the kettle stopped heating after 9 days, not 19 as the ticket form says (typo on our side). Akosua offered a replacement; Mrs Brandvold declined and wants a refund instead.
Correction from Tomasz this afternoon: the refund is €44.10, not €49.00, because she used a 10% loyalty voucher. We refund only what she actually paid.
Policy check: full refund only if she returns the base as well as the jug. She thinks she may have thrown the box away; that's fine, packaging isn't required.
Tomasz has NOT issued anything yet. He wants whoever picks this up to confirm the return label was sent before approving. If she calls back upset, don't offer a goodwill credit unless Akosua or Tomasz signs it off.
